headline: Six uploads, no run failures, one rapid-fire missed Instagram and Facebook.
happened: Two Shorts and four rapid-fires went out, with no long-form.
The 22 UTC rapid-fire hit a cross-post error and skipped Instagram and Facebook.
YouTube took that rapid-fire as a public seven-round Electric-type quiz.
watch: Analytics runs four days behind, so the newest views are Nov 21.
The release-staging step for cross-posting failed once, so watch for repeats.
Credits are far under pace and reset on Dec 9.
